name: Atlas Mountains, Morocco
shortDescription: Six days moving through the High Atlas by foot and mule track, ending at the edge of the Sahara.
description:
The trip

Six days through Berber villages and mountain passes most travelers never see, ending with two nights camped at the edge of the Sahara. Small group, local guides, no fixed itinerary beyond the broad shape of the route.

This isn't a checklist of landmarks - it's six days that ask something of you. Expect long days on foot, basic accommodation, and a group of strangers who won't be strangers by the end of it.
